documents.title: Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30, 2026
Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of Unaudited Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter Ended June 30, 2026

analysis.summary: Pix Transmissions reported strong financial performance for FY 2024-25, crossing 600 crores in consolidated turnover and achieving a net worth exceeding 500 crores with very low debt levels. Management highlighted macroeconomic volatility, including ongoing geopolitical conflicts and tariff wars, but noted that India remains the world's fastest-growing major economy. The company approved a capital expenditure project for a 9.3 MW captive solar power plant estimated at Rs 30 Crores. Additionally, the Board recommended a dividend of Rs 9.00 per equity share for the financial year.

guidance.claim: The Reserve Bank of India projected India's GDP growth at 6.3% for FY 2025-26.
guidance.quote: We continue to retain our position as the world’s fastest growing major economy with GDP growth pegged at 6.3% in FY 2025-26.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that wars and tariff-wars are creating new dimensions and challenges in global trade.
demand_outlook.quote: In 2025, not only are we plagued with wars spanning geographies but the tariff-wars have added a whole new dimension to how countries will trade with each other in the times to come.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that the business is facing volatility, uncertainty, wars across geographies, and tariff-wars.
risks_headwinds.quote: In my over five decades of working experience, I have yet to witness more volatility and uncertainty than at present.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
